name: wigoo
description: Find travel eSIM plans for 190+ countries and regions, with networks, data, validity and prices in the traveler's currency.

interface.longDescription:
Wigoo sells data eSIMs for travelers in more than 190 countries and multi-country regions. Ask about a trip and ChatGPT can look up which destinations are covered, which mobile networks each plan uses, the data sizes and validity periods on sale, whether unlimited day passes and top ups exist, and the list price in any of 55 currencies.

The plugin is read only. It never places orders, takes payments or asks for personal data. When the traveler has chosen a plan, it returns a link to that plan's page on getwigoo.com, where the purchase happens. No Wigoo account is needed to buy: an email address is enough.

publication.release_notes: First release: search destinations, destination facts, plan lists and price quotes with a link to buy on getwigoo.com.

positive.description: Find a destination and its starting price
positive.prompt: I'm going to Japan next month. Does Wigoo have an eSIM for it and how much does it start at?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Japan (id jp), names its networks and gives the starting price in US dollars.

positive.prompt: What should I know about Wigoo's eSIM for Turkey? Can I top it up?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the networks, the data sizes and validity options, says whether unlimited day passes exist and that top ups are supported, and explains that the eSIM needs a compatible, unlocked phone.

positive.prompt: Show me the Wigoo plans for Europe in euros, only the unlimited ones.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Europe region and lists only its unlimited day passes, with the daily amount at full speed, the validity and the price in EUR.

positive.description: Quote a specific plan with a buy link
positive.prompt: I want 10 GB for 30 days in Japan, priced in pounds. Give me the link to buy it.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the 10 GB, 30 day Japan plan in GBP and returns a getwigoo.com link that opens that plan, with the steps to buy using only an email address.

positive.description: Search with a name in another language
positive.prompt: Quanto costa una eSIM Wigoo per la Germania? Rispondi in italiano.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Germany (id de) from the Italian name and answers in Italian with the starting price and networks.

negative.description: Physical SIM card, not an eSIM
negative.prompt: Where can I buy a physical SIM card at Rome airport?
Book me a hotel in Paris for next weekend.
Which mobile phone contract is cheapest for my home country?

review.commerce_description: The plugin helps travelers choose an eSIM data plan, a digital telecom service, and returns a link to the plan's product page on getwigoo.com. Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT: the purchase, the payment and the delivery of the eSIM all happen on our website, run by Wigoo Labs LLC, through our own Stripe checkout.
